headline: Nevish Line Erupts While Weathered Expanse Bleeds in Place
war_summary: The closing hours have brought a fresh storm to the Nevish Line, where losses leapt from a trickle to better than seventeen hundred in two watches, all eight works yet Warden-held. Mooring County remained the freshest field, recording flag changes up to the very minute of this dispatch, Wiccwalk its most fought-over post and the day's toll near fourteen thousand. The Linn of Mercy kept up its punishing trade, Warden losses there topping five thousand for the day about Lathair. Weathered Expanse bleeds without moving: no flag event in six hours, yet losses near two thousand an hour and a day's bill of some twenty-nine and a half thousand, the count frozen at six Warden works to three Colonial. Stonecradle yielded a work to the Colonials, standing five Warden to four, while Stlican Shelf, where Wardens reclaimed eight works across the day, went silent through the final two hours. Fishermans Row and Farranac Coast rest quiet under single flags, and Marban Hollow's contested Mox post has gone silent since late afternoon. The ledger reads 294 works Colonial against 142 Warden; not one base lies in ruin. Day 269; no victor declared.
